mapper.sql:
WHERE p.use_yn = 'Y'
AND (LOWER(p.title) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(p.content) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%')
mapper.select:
SELECT p.id, p.title, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(p.content, 200, 1) AS content, u.nickname, p.view_count, (SELECT COUNT(c.id) FROM post_comments c WHERE c.board_type = 'F' AND c.post_id = p.id AND c.use_yn = 'Y') AS comment_count, TO_CHAR(p.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS created_at, CASE WHEN p.file_yn = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_file FROM free_posts p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT p.id, p.user_id, p.title, p.content, p.file_yn, p.file_name, p.file_org_name, p.file_path, p.file_ext, p.file_size, p.view_count, p.use_yn, p.created_at, p.updated_at, u.nickname FROM free_posts p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE p.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO free_posts (user_id, title, content) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content})
mapper.update: UPDATE free_posts SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, updated_at = SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE free_posts SET use_yn = 'N', updated_at = SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE free_posts SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND use_yn = 'Y'

UPDATE free_posts SET file_yn = 'Y', file_name = #{fileName}, file_org_name = #{fileOrgName}, file_path = #{filePath}, file_ext = #{fileExt}, file_size = #{fileSize}, updated_at = SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE free_posts SET file_yn = 'N', file_name = NULL, file_org_name = NULL, file_path = NULL, file_ext = NULL, file_size = NULL, updated_at = SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) WHERE id = #{id}
